claims.harm: unmotivated change if a node with the base block downloaded is already near the snapshot height
claims.quote: why would someone load a snapshot when they already downloaded the block, which means that their tip must be no more than 1024 blocks behind that block.
claims.settled_by_quote: The case covered here is that this blockstorage state is accepted through local block submission/import before snapshot activation.

result.notes: mzumsande questioned the usefulness of supporting snapshot loading when the base block is already present; shuv-amp clarified that out-of-band imports such as submitblock trigger this state and lead to crashes, resolving the concern with no further pushback.
